newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers higher but margins, demand thin.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers higher but margins, demand thin.

text.p: Singapore bunker quotes moved $3-$4 per tonne higher on Tuesday as support in the cargo market is expected to persist, traders said.

Bunker 380-cst supplies were quoted at $101 per tonne with a handful of majors moving as high as $102 per tonne, traders said. Bunker 180-cst supplies were quoted by majors at $105-$106 and independents $2-$3 lower.

But as bunker enquiries were thin, bunker margins were small. "We could only quote a $1-$2 premium over cargo quotes eventhough barge and other operating costs are usually between $3-$4", a major said. -- Singapore Newsroom (65-870 3082)
